title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线很清晰：agent 开始接管操作系统。Claude 有了自己的浏览器，Codex 上线了 native apps，Vercel 给 agents 配上了全球算力——工具层正在从「命令行」走向「第一公民应用」。另一边，一个 100 亿美元的对冲基金让全部 400 名员工强制上 AI，Aaron Levie 则点破了反面的真相：再强的超级智能，也取决于它能拿到多少企业上下文。当工具和心态同时到位，剩下的问题就变成了——钱和注意力该往哪里押。

sections.title: Agent-Native Products / Agent 原生产品
sections.desc: 工具层的关键一步：agent 不再住在终端里，开始变成有浏览器、有原生应用、有算力底座的一等公民。

rewrite: Claude is shipping a native browser, and it's a real moment for agent workflows. In Cowork, when a task involves a website, a browser opens in the side panel and Claude navigates, fills forms, and finishes the job itself.

A Claude in Chrome extension is now generally available on paid plans, and a built-in browser is rolling out in the desktop app over the next week. Nothing to install, and it stays separate from your own browser and logins.
original: Claude now has its own built-in browser in Cowork. When your task involves a website, a browser opens in Cowork's side panel, and Claude navigates, fills forms, and finishes the job.
If you prefer to work in your own browser where you're already signed in, Claude in Chrome is now generally available on all paid plans. It remains your default if you already use it.
There's nothing to install. Claude's browser is built into the desktop app and stays separate from your own browser and logins. Rolling out over the next week on the desktop app for all paid plans.

rewrite: Claude 正在推出自己的原生浏览器，这对 agent 工作流来说是个标志性时刻。在 Cowork 里，当任务涉及网站时，侧边栏会打开一个浏览器，Claude 自己导航、填表单、把活儿干完。
Claude in Chrome 扩展已面向所有付费计划正式开放，桌面 App 也将在接下来一周内置一个浏览器。无需安装任何东西，而且它和你的浏览器、登录状态完全隔离。
original: Claude 现在在 Cowork 里有了自己的内置浏览器。当你的任务涉及网站时，Cowork 侧边栏会打开浏览器，Claude 导航、填表单、把活儿干完。
如果你更想在自己已登录的浏览器里工作，Claude in Chrome 现已面向所有付费计划正式开放。如果你已经在用，它会保持为你的默认。
无需安装任何东西。Claude 的浏览器内置于桌面 App，与你的浏览器和登录状态隔离。接下来一周将向所有付费计划推出。

rewrite: Dan Shipper is hyped about Codex shipping native apps. 'Codex native apps are here!' he posts, following up with an emphatic 'THEY DID IT FOLKS.'

For Shipper — who runs Every, a media company built around tracking the edge of AI — this is the moment coding agents stop living inside the terminal and start shipping as first-class desktop applications.
original: Codex native apps are here!
THEY DID IT FOLKS

rewrite: Dan Shipper 对 Codex 上线原生应用这件事很兴奋。他发推说「Codex native apps 来了！」，随后又补了一句情绪拉满的「他们做到了，伙计们」。
对 Shipper 来说——他经营的 Every 是一家专注追踪 AI 前沿的媒体公司——这标志着 coding agent 不再困在终端里，而是开始以第一公民桌面应用的身份出货。
original: Codex 原生应用来了！
他们做到了，伙计们

rewrite: Vercel is turning itself into the compute layer for agents. CEO Guillermo Rauch announces global compute at your agents' fingertips: multiple regions, failover, up to 10,000 concurrent sandboxes and 5,000 vCPUs/min ramp by default.

He's also shipping a `vercel security check` CLI, so you can call on agents to improve your security posture with human-in-the-loop or run it in crons. His quip: 'Who would have thunk CLIs would save the world.'
original: So cool. Global compute at your (agents') fingertips. Multiple regions, failover, up to 10,000 concurrent sandboxes & 5,000 vCPUs/min ramp by default, with more regions to come.

We're shipping a cool security dashboard, but also the vercel security check CLI. Much like is-agentic, you can call on agents to improve your security posture with human-in-the-loop, or run in crons. Who would have thunk CLIs would save the world.

rewrite: Vercel 正在把自己变成 agents 的算力层。CEO Guillermo Rauch 宣布了「触手可及的全球算力」：多区域、故障转移、默认高达 10,000 个并发 sandbox 和每分钟 5,000 vCPU 的扩容能力。
他还发布了 `vercel security check` CLI——你可以调用 agent 来提升安全态势，带人在回路，或跑在 cron 里。他调侃道：「谁能想到 CLI 会拯救世界。」
original: 太酷了。全球算力触手可及（你的 agents 的）。多区域、故障转移、默认高达 10,000 个并发 sandbox 和每分钟 5,000 vCPU 的扩容，更多区域即将上线。
我们发布了一个很酷的安全 dashboard，还有 vercel security check CLI。很像 is-agentic，你可以调用 agent 来提升安全态势，带人在回路，或跑在 cron 里。谁能想到 CLI 会拯救世界。

sections.title: A $10B Hedge Fund Goes AI-First / 百亿对冲基金的 AI 打法
sections.desc: 一个管理近 100 亿美元的对冲基金 CEO 用自己的方式回答了「AI 会不会抢工作」：不是会不会，而是你还不赶紧用。

rewrite: The takeaway: a $10 billion hedge fund is betting that AI fluency is now a job requirement, not a perk. Walleye Capital's Will (an Oxford math PhD and former Princeton engineer) wrote a firm-wide memo that opens with 'I use ChatGPT to write this email — you should be using it too and be proud of it.' His answer to the 'is it cheating' anxiety: 'Using ChatGPT is not cheating... not using these tools is like refusing to use the internet in 1995 because it wasn't perfect.'

Walleye now trains every one of its ~400 employees on AI basics, runs weekly leaderboards and internal meetups, and built an internal digital-analyst tool called Current that every fundamental investing team uses. He credits the turning point to a March 2023 demo by a junior analyst who had used GPT-3 to automate parts of his own job. His analogy for the moment: Merlin in The Sword in the Stone, who can see the future but not the steps in between.
original: Using ChatGPT is not cheating. That's a non applicable idea from academia. I use ChatGPT to write this email. You should be using it too and be proud of it. As a hedge fund, we should be ashamed to leave money on the table by ignoring tools that make us faster, smarter, and more effective.
From the very top, we are building a culture around AI. Not using these tools is like refusing to use the Internet in 1995 because it wasn't perfect.

rewrite: 核心结论：一个百亿美元的对冲基金在赌一件事——AI 熟练度现在已经是岗位要求，而不是额外福利。Walleye Capital 的 Will（牛津数学博士、前普林斯顿工程师）给全公司写了一封备忘录，开头就是「我用 ChatGPT 写了这封邮件，你也该用，并且为此自豪。」他对「这算不算作弊」焦虑的回答是：「用 ChatGPT 不是作弊……不用这些工具，就像 1995 年因为互联网不够完美而拒绝用它。」
Walleye 现在让全部约 400 名员工接受 AI 基础培训，跑每周排行榜和内部交流会，还自研了一款叫 Current 的数字分析师工具，每个基本面投资团队都在用。他把转折点归结于 2023 年 3 月一个初级分析师的 demo——那人用 GPT-3 自动化了自己的一部分工作。他对当下的比喻是：《石中剑》里的梅林，能看见未来，却看不见中间的路。
original: 用 ChatGPT 不是作弊。那是学术界不适用的一套观念。我用 ChatGPT 写了这封邮件，你也该用，并且为此自豪。作为一家对冲基金，放着让我们更快、更聪明、更高效的工具不用，把钱留在桌上，我们才该感到羞愧。
从最高层开始，我们要围绕 AI 建立一种文化。不用这些工具，就像 1995 年因为互联网不够完美而拒绝用它。

sections.title: Enterprise AI: Context Is the Moat / 企业 AI：上下文是护城河
sections.desc: Levie 给出了企业级 AI 的另一面：模型再强，没有数据上下文也是白搭；安全与治理正在变成硬需求。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie reports Q2 revenue of $321.1 million, up 11% in constant currency — the highest growth in 14 quarters — and raises full-year guidance to $1.29 billion, crediting enterprise demand to unlock content in the AI era.

His core thesis: the world's most advanced superintelligence is only as useful as the enterprise knowledge it can access. Agents need contracts, research, financials and roadmaps — most of which live in unstructured data. As token usage grows exponentially, enterprises will need platforms that let them swap models or agents at any time, plus guardrails, audit logs and real-time security alerts as external agents touch corporate data.
original: Yesterday, at Box we reported our Q2 results with revenue of $321.1 million for the quarter, up 9%, or 11% in constant currency (our highest constant-currency growth rate in 14 quarters), and we raised our full-year revenue target to $1.290 billion.

The world's most advanced superintelligence is only as useful as the underlying enterprise knowledge it has access to. Agents need access to the critical information that makes up the bulk of corporate knowledge — like contracts, research materials, financial documents, marketing assets, product roadmap information, and so on — most of which lives within an enterprise's unstructured data.

As external AI agents interact with enterprise data, enterprises will need platforms that offer robust guardrails, comprehensive audit logs, and real-time security alerts to ensure content remains protected and governed at all times.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 公布第二季度营收 3.211 亿美元，按固定汇率计算增长 11%——创下 14 个季度以来的最高增速——并把全年指引上调到 12.9 亿美元，他把增长归因于企业在 AI 时代释放内容价值的需求。
他的核心论点：世界上最强的超级智能，能发挥多大作用取决于它能访问多少企业知识。agent 需要合同、研究资料、财务、路线图——这些大多躺在非结构化数据里。随着 token 用量指数级增长，企业将需要能随时切换模型或 agent 的平台，以及外接 agent 接触企业数据时的护栏、审计日志和实时安全告警。
original: 昨天，Box 公布了第二季度业绩：本季度营收 3.211 亿美元，增长 9%，按固定汇率计算增长 11%（14 个季度以来的最高固定汇率增速），并将全年营收目标上调至 12.9 亿美元。
世界上最强的超级智能，能发挥多大作用取决于它能访问多少底层企业知识。agent 需要访问构成企业知识主体的关键信息——比如合同、研究资料、财务文件、营销资产、产品路线图等——而这些大多存在于企业的非结构化数据中。
当外部 AI agent 与企业数据交互时，企业需要能提供强大护栏、全面审计日志和实时安全告警的平台，以确保内容始终受到保护和管理。

sections.title: The Frontier and the Money / 前沿与资本
sections.desc: 资本在押注两个方向：后训练（post-training）决定前沿，而开源 AI 正在围绕单一引力中心整合。

rewrite: SPC's Aditya Agarwal argues the AI frontier will be determined by post-training, and is putting money behind it: DeepCogito, a post-training research lab, is announcing a $43M Series A.

The lab focuses on large-scale reinforcement learning and recursive self-improvement, built around iterated distillation and amplification (IDA), and says it has proven the method in public on models from 3B to 600B+ parameters. Agarwal met the founders as Founder Fellows at SPC in March 2024.
original: The AI frontier will be determined by post-training. @DeepCogito is a post-training research lab. Today they're announcing their $43M Series A. Their research focuses on large-scale reinforcement learning and recursive self-improvement. The core method is iterated distillation and amplification (IDA). They've already proven the method in public for models from 3B to 600B+ parameters.

rewrite: SPC 的 Aditya Agarwal 认为 AI 前沿将由后训练（post-training）决定，并真金白银下注：后训练研究实验室 DeepCogito 宣布完成 4300 万美元的 A 轮融资。
该实验室专注于大规模强化学习和递归自我改进，核心方法是迭代蒸馏与放大（IDA），并称已在 3B 到 600B+ 参数的模型上公开验证了这套方法。Agarwal 是在 2024 年 3 月作为 SPC 的 Founder Fellows 认识这两位创始人的。
original: AI 前沿将由后训练决定。@DeepCogito 是一家后训练研究实验室。今天他们宣布完成 4300 万美元 A 轮。其研究聚焦于大规模强化学习和递归自我改进，核心方法是迭代蒸馏与放大（IDA）。他们已在 3B 到 600B+ 参数的模型上公开验证了这套方法。

rewrite: FirstMark's Matt Turck frames NVIDIA's move into open source AI — with Nemotron and now Hugging Face — as a 'win-win-win': NVIDIA becomes the center of open source AI, Hugging Face gets the perfect home and sheds its business-model question, and open source AI wins.
For Turck, the open-source AI ecosystem just consolidated around a single gravitational center.
original: Truly a win-win-win: NVIDIA is officially the center of open source AI w/ Nemotron and now HF. Hugging Face scores huge + gets the perfect home (no more nagging re business model!). Open source AI wins! Massive congrats to friends @ClementDelangue, @Thom_Wolf (+ @ctnzr!)

rewrite: FirstMark 的 Matt Turck 把 NVIDIA 进军开源 AI（先有 Nemotron，现在又拿下 Hugging Face）定义为一桩「三赢」：NVIDIA 正式成为开源 AI 的中心，Hugging Face 拿到完美归宿、甩掉了商业模式的老问题，开源 AI 成为赢家。
在 Turck 看来，开源 AI 生态刚刚围绕单一引力中心完成了整合。
original: 真正的三赢：NVIDIA 凭借 Nemotron 和现在的 HF，正式成为开源 AI 的中心。Hugging Face 大获全胜，拿到完美归宿（不用再为商业模式操心了！）。开源 AI 赢了！向 @ClementDelangue、@Thom_Wolf（还有 @ctnzr）致以热烈祝贺！

sections.title: Mindset, Bubbles and the Moment / 心态、泡沫与时代
sections.desc: 产品之外，是心态的分野：有人为泡沫焦虑，有人对 AI 写作双重标准，还有人在 OpenAI 里感受时间被压缩。

rewrite: Zara Zhang takes two contrarian swings in one day. First: most PR teams at large companies exist to block real marketing and branding — ironic for a function designed to enhance the brand.

Second: when it comes to AI writing, people apply a double standard — 'it's fine if I use it, it's not fine if YOU use it.' Both point at the same gap: institutions that claim to embrace AI while resisting what AI actually changes.
original: Most PR teams at large companies exist in order to block real marketing and branding. It's so ironic that a function designed to enhance a company's brand ends up being antithetical to it.
When it comes to AI writing, many people seem to apply a double standard to the effect of 'it's fine if I use it; it's not fine if YOU use it'

rewrite: Zara Zhang 一天之内抛出两个反直觉观点。其一：大公司的公关团队大多是为了「阻挡真正的营销和品牌」而存在——一个本该提升品牌的职能，结果却成了品牌的对立面，这很讽刺。
其二：谈到 AI 写作，很多人用的是双重标准——「我用没问题，你用就不行」。这两点指向同一个断层：机构一边声称拥抱 AI，一边抗拒 AI 真正改变的东西。
original: 大公司的公关团队大多是为了阻挡真正的营销和品牌而存在的。一个本该提升公司品牌的职能，最后却变成了品牌的对立面，这太讽刺了。
谈到 AI 写作，很多人似乎都用双重标准，效果就是「我用没问题；你用就不行」。

rewrite: Peter Steinberger, who came back from retirement to build OpenClaw, notes Codex's visualization feature 'got really good' — a small signal that coding agents are maturing fast.
But in the same breath he wonders 'maybe it is a bubble?' The tension between 'this is getting good' and 'is this a bubble' captures the mood of the moment.
original: codex' visualization feature got really good.
maybe it is a bubble?

rewrite: 退休后又复出做 OpenClaw 的 Peter Steinberger 注意到 Codex 的可视化功能「变得相当好了」——这是 coding agent 快速成熟的一个小信号。
但紧接着他又嘀咕了一句「也许这是泡沫？」「这玩意儿越来越好」和「这是不是泡沫」之间的张力，恰好抓住了当下的情绪。
original: Codex 的可视化功能变得相当好了。
也许这是泡沫？

rewrite: Thibault Sottiaux, who works on Codex and ChatGPT at OpenAI, offers a raw window into the company's pace: 'A few weeks at OpenAI feel like years at other companies in terms of how much gets done.'
He jokes about aging — it feels like 20 years since he pressed the reset button — a nod to how fast a career and a field moves when you're inside the machine.
original: A few weeks at OpenAI feel like years at other companies in terms of how much gets done. Crazy how much you can age in a few days.
A good thing about having aged is that I feel that it's been 20 years since I've pressed the reset button. Intrigued to see if I can find it tomorrow and dust it up.

rewrite: 在 OpenAI 做 Codex 和 ChatGPT 的 Thibault Sottiaux 给出了一个公司节奏的直观窗口：「在 OpenAI 待几周，完成的量抵得上别家公司几年。」
他还拿「变老」开玩笑——感觉离上一次按下重置键已经过去 20 年——这是对「身在这台机器里，职业和领域都跑得飞快」的一种调侃。
original: 就完成量而言，在 OpenAI 待几周，抵得上在别的公司待几年。几天之内就能老这么多，太疯狂了。
变老的一个好处是，我感觉离上一次按下重置键已经过去 20 年了。很好奇明天还能不能找到它、把它重新擦亮。
